selection: H50 uses one model response per task. model_read_ids are baseline; final_read_ids after hybrid closure are treatment.
treatment: Up to six pinned-base effect-overlap reads when effects exist; otherwise widest delivered base observation for each of the four most repeatedly observed paths.

branch_order.method: one candidate branch per task; baseline reconstructed from identical terminal response

claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
